checks.label: Business details for Google
checks.summary: Business details are missing the address.
checks.explanation: The site tells Google it is a ProfessionalService, but leaves out the address. Those are the details Google checks against the Google Business Profile, so gaps here weaken the match.

tasks.title: Add the city and service to the page title
tasks.label: Title tag
tasks.why: The page title is the blue headline in Google results. It is 83 characters, so Google cuts it off after about 60. It does not mention Newton. Someone searching for web design in Newton may scroll past it.

tasks.title: Add business details Google can read (name, address, phone, hours)
tasks.label: Business details for Google
tasks.why: The site tells Google it is a ProfessionalService, but leaves out the address. Those are the details Google checks against the Google Business Profile, so gaps here weaken the match.

tasks.title: Mention the city and main service in the page copy
tasks.label: City and service on the page
tasks.why: The words are on the page, but not in the title or headings, where Google and visitors look first. Moving them up improves your chances of showing for "web design in Newton".

tasks.title: Write a meta description that names the service and city
tasks.label: Meta description
tasks.why: This is the short paragraph under the title in Google. It is 168 characters, and Google cuts it off around 160. A tighter sentence that names the service and the next step gives people a reason to click.

tasks.title: Give the home page one clear main heading
tasks.label: Main heading
tasks.why: The main heading is the first line most visitors read. The main heading does not say "Web design". When it is clear, fewer people leave before they call.
